processes.name: Daily volume reporting
processes.definition: Sending the day's flowing volumes to the team each morning and answering questions about them.
include: The morning volume report and replies to it
exclude: Corrections to a past month's meter volumes: meter-volume-correction

processes.name: Meter volume correction
processes.definition: Correcting the recorded volume at a meter for a past day or month after someone finds a discrepancy.
include: Requests to correct, reallocate or rebook a meter's volume

processes.name: Deal ticket set-up
processes.definition: Creating or extending a deal ticket in the trading system so that gas can be scheduled against it.
include: Requests for a new or extended ticket

processes.name: Month-end close schedule
processes.definition: Agreeing and circulating the dates and deadlines of the monthly accounting close.

processes.name: Credit report request
processes.definition: Asking the credit group for a counterparty's credit report before trading with it.
include: Requests for a credit report or credit limit

processes.name: System access request
processes.definition: Requesting, approving and confirming a person's access to a company system.
exclude: Password resets for one's own account

processes.name: Pipeline nomination
processes.definition: Sending and confirming the volumes nominated on a pipeline for the next gas day, and revising them.

processes.name: Weekend on-call handover
processes.definition: Handing over to the weekend on-call scheduler and recording what happened while on call.
